roles.background: variation of Hodge structure, period maps, Hodge/Noether-Lefschetz loci
roles.delegation: audit which scheme structure is logically relevant to the rational pointwise variational target
roles.finding: nilpotent thickening can change infinitesimal Hodge-locus structure without changing the complex-point support; full scheme tangent is therefore an extra strengthening unless explicitly required
roles.objection: do not erase scheme structure when studying infinitesimal Hodge theory itself
roles.recommendation: split root-aligned reduced-support domination from scheme-theoretic infinitesimal strengthening

roles.background: Hilbert/Chow/flag-Hilbert schemes, families of cycles, properness
roles.delegation: audit the witness-side geometric target and coefficient bookkeeping
roles.finding: a proper exact-category witness-incidence component dominating a dense open of an irreducible reduced branch gives a more direct set-theoretic target; selected-witness component switching remains a separate issue
roles.objection: one effective Hilbert component cannot encode an arbitrary signed rational witness
roles.recommendation: retain coefficient vector/component data and formulate domination for an exact finite signed witness category

roles.background: first-order deformation theory, obstruction theories, reduced obstruction/semiregularity
roles.delegation: test whether tangent-surjectivity is necessary at nonreduced/singular targets
roles.finding: dual-number tangent spaces see nilpotents; requiring all such directions to lift can exceed pointwise branch domination
roles.objection: at a smooth reduced point, differential surjectivity remains a useful sufficient local certificate
roles.recommendation: use tangent surjectivity only on a separately verified smooth reduced locus or for a declared infinitesimal-strengthening child

roles.background: degeneration, specialization, limiting Hodge structures, monodromy
roles.finding: proper-image closure may extend generic reduced domination across singular points inside a fixed irreducible support, but it does not solve component switching, monodromy, singular degeneration, or global continuation
roles.objection: do not infer specialization across a changed singular family from a local proper-image statement
roles.recommendation: leave degeneration/monodromy as separate frozen children

roles.delegation: produce the cheapest boundary case against the inherited full-tangent target
roles.finding: Dan's divisor/Noether-Lefschetz setting supplies nonreduced Hodge-locus components in a codimension-one world where pointwise rational (1,1) algebraicity is solved; the dual-numbers toy model isolates why support and tangent scheme can diverge
roles.objection: nonreducedness alone does not identify which tangent directions fail to come from witnesses
roles.recommendation: claim only target overreach/nonequivalence, not a failure of witness incidence or a new Hodge theorem

roles.background: formal specification, proof-gate design, novelty auditing, RAKL v3 metrology
roles.delegation: type the claim, falsifier, authority and telemetry
roles.finding: the prospective result is route normalization/representation correction; it has no root theorem, novelty, independent-review or reusable-tool authority
roles.objection: repository growth and same-context consensus are not learning or independent validation
roles.recommendation: record prospective receipt, TaskEpisode, diagnosis, lesson/obstruction separately; mark v3 state fingerprints CANNOT_MEASURE if no canonical RAKLV3State exists

discussion_summary: The inherited H4d1c priority of full Hodge-tangent surjectivity is retained only as a sufficient smooth-reduced local certificate, not as the root-aligned target.
The cell agrees to test the solved divisor/nonreduced boundary before any new theorem mechanism.
The cell preserves a separate scheme-theoretic infinitesimal branch for researchers who intentionally want nilpotent/higher-order Hodge-locus lifting.
disagreements_preserved: The deformation specialist would still value full tangent surjectivity on verified smooth reduced points; the adversarial/VHS roles oppose using it unqualified at nonreduced or singular points.

The cycle-moduli role warns that reduced-branch domination can require changing witness components; the current fixed-witness lane cannot silently treat class-level existence as selected-witness lifting.
